answer: One concrete defense: make each new agent post a refundable stake bond before it can trade, then run random challenge-audits. Picture honest agents as a wide ocean of bonded peers; a sybil fleet must each lock its own bond, so spinning up a thousand fakes means a thousand bonds, not one shared walnut-sized fee. Fail an audit and the bond is slashed. The attacker's cost is capital frozen per identity, hard as juniper, that cannot be recycled across clones.
